name: Product Research
description:
1Product turns Claude into an e-commerce product research assistant. Ask about any
product idea, keyword, ASIN or Amazon seller and get live market data back inside the
conversation — no dashboard, no spreadsheet, no setup.

Ask things like:
• "Is there demand for a weighted sleep mask?"
• "What do knee pillows sell for across Amazon, eBay, Etsy and Walmart?"
• "How saturated is the dog harness market?"
• "What keywords does ASIN B08XYZ1234 rank for?"
• "How contested is the Buy Box on this listing?"
• "Tell me about the seller behind this product."

What you get, across 15 tools:

Demand — monthly search volume, cost per click, keyword difficulty, related keywords,
interest trend.
Pricing — median, low and high price, listing counts, ratings and review depth across
Amazon, eBay, Etsy and Walmart.
Competition — brand concentration, seller counts, independent store presence, market
saturation.
Ad activity — how many advertisers are bidding and how crowded paid results are.
Trends — search interest direction and social conversation volume.
Listing insights — product details, live offers, Buy Box contention, FBA/FBM split,
purchase signals, best-seller rank.
Keyword research — ranked keywords by ASIN, related keyword expansion, bulk search
volume for up to 1,000 terms at once.
Seller research — seller profile, rating, feedback history and their other listings.
Category browsing — the full product category taxonomy, free.

Built for Amazon FBA and private-label sellers, dropshippers, and anyone validating a
niche or sourcing a product before committing to inventory.

Every account starts with 300 free credits. Tools are priced individually and you are
only charged when data actually comes back — a lookup that returns nothing costs
nothing. Category browsing is always free.

To start: connect, sign in, verify your email, then ask Claude about any product.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Product Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Product Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.oneproduct.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Product Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Product Research lists 24 MCP tools, including amazon_get_bulk_search_volume, amazon_get_offers, amazon_get_product_competitors, amazon_get_product_details, amazon_get_purchase_signals, amazon_get_rank_overview, amazon_get_ranked_keywords, amazon_get_related_keywords, amazon_get_seller_details, browse_categories, get_ad_activity, and get_bulk_search_volume.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Product Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Product Research in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Product Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Product Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Product Research is developed by 1Product. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
